summary: This bill repeals the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978 and requires federal officers to obtain a warrant using Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure before conducting electronic surveillance or physical searches targeting U.S. citizens for foreign intelligence purposes, while also prohibiting the use of certain acquired information against U.S. citizens in legal proceedings.
